english.title: Smoke in smoke-free vehicle - Wales
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) smoked in a smoke-free vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5(1)(b) and (6) of the Public Health (Wales) Act 2017.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Smoke-free vehicles are defined in regulation 15 of the Smoke-free Premises and Vehicles (Wales) Regulations 2020, for exemptions see regulation 16.
(ii) For a defence where the person did not know, and could not reasonably have been expected to know, that the vehicle was a smoke-free vehicle, see section 5 of the Public Health (Wales) Act 2017.
(iii) The fixed penalty amount is £100 (regulation 20(b)); the discounted amount £75 (regulation 21(b)). For the form of the fixed penalty notice, see regulation 22.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant smoked in a smoke-free vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE..).

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level one on the standard scale.

Fixed penalty ticket - one hundred pounds.

Discounted amount - seventy-five pounds.

Time limit for prosecution:
6 months
